title: Traffic light with pedestrian request
summary: Car lights on LED0 (green), LED1 (yellow), LED2 (red): green 4 s, yellow 1 s, red 3 s, repeat. Pressing BTNL requests a crossing: after the next red phase a 3 s 'walk' phase follows (red plus the walk light on LED3). BTNC restarts the cycle at green.

outputs.name: lights
outputs.description: bit0 green, bit1 yellow, bit2 red, bit3 walk

assumptions: The light starts green after configuration
A request is remembered until it is served; the walk phase keeps the car light red
